platform: native Windows x86_64, developer machine (Sundetali7), debug build of agentfw
base_commit: 215b99e (origin/main) plus the uncommitted SOU-81 working tree
scope: PackagedClassifier directly (no collector, no daemon): 15 cold starts (fresh worker, first call includes spawn, Job Object assignment, bootstrap hash checks and classifier import), 300 warm calls on one worker, 20 single-shot subprocess calls (python -I -u -X utf8 script) on the same input shape. Deadlines (1.4 s start, 1.4 s request) and retries unchanged: there are none.

cold_start_deadline.finding: On this machine the slowest cold start used about a quarter of the unchanged 1400 ms start deadline. No failure was observed, so no deadline was relaxed and no retry was added. A slower machine or heavy antivirus scanning of a first python.exe launch could consume more; the CI run records the same distribution on a hosted runner.

limits: One developer machine, one run; the distribution is evidence, not a guarantee.
Debug build; release timing was not measured.
Not a generalization or accuracy claim: latency only.
